Lethal Enforcers II - Gun Fighters.name: Lethal Enforcers II: Gun Fighters
Lethal Enforcers II - Gun Fighters.summary: Lethal Enforcers II: Gun Fighters is a 1994 arcade and prequel to the original Lethal Enforcers. In contrast with the first game's modern law enforcement theme, Lethal Enforcers II takes place in the American Old West.
